content.value_statement: Vitest projects can be difficult to configure when tests, mocks, coverage, and environments interact. This skill provides focused Vitest guidance and version-aware examples.
actual_capabilities: Explains Vitest APIs for tests, suites, hooks, assertions, and fixtures.
Drafts configurations for environments, projects, coverage, and reporters.
Creates mocking approaches for modules, functions, timers, globals, and environment variables.
Guides filtering, tags, concurrency, sharding, and watch mode.
Supports snapshots, type tests, and benchmark planning.
Identifies documented migration details across recent Vitest versions.
limitations: The guidance targets Vitest 5 beta and may not reflect later API changes.
The skill does not install packages or run tests by itself.
It cannot verify behavior without access to the project and runtime.
Placeholder examples require adaptation to each project.

use_cases.title: Create component tests
use_cases.description: Build focused unit and component tests with suitable assertions, fixtures, and browser-like environments.

use_cases.title: Migrate a Jest suite
use_cases.description: Map Jest patterns to Vitest and identify configuration, mocking, snapshot, and compatibility changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize CI testing
use_cases.description: Plan coverage, reporters, filtering, sharding, and project settings for repeatable continuous integration runs.

prompt_templates.title: Write a basic unit test
prompt_templates.prompt: Write Vitest tests for [function] in [file]. Cover normal input, one edge case, and one error case. Use clear assertions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting test coverage for a small function.

prompt_templates.title: Mock a dependency
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Vitest tests for [module]. Mock [dependency] with vi.mock, reset state after each test, and explain why each mock is needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Isolating code from an external dependency.

prompt_templates.title: Configure coverage and CI
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Vitest configuration for [project type]. Set [environment], coverage thresholds, reporters, and CI behavior. Explain every nondefault choice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Establishing a repeatable project test configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Design a multi-project strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Vitest strategy for [workspace]. Include projects, fixtures, sharding, tags, snapshots, and migration risks. State assumptions and verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinating advanced tests across a large workspace.

output_examples.input: Plan tests for a price calculator with discounts and rounding.
output_examples.output: Proposed suite: standard pricing, zero quantity, invalid discounts, and rounding boundaries. The plan identifies setup, expected behavior, and focused assertions.

output_examples.input: Recommend Vitest settings for a browser component library in CI.
output: Use a browser-like environment for component tests.
Apply explicit coverage thresholds to source files.
Select concise CI reporting and split large suites with sharding.

output_examples.input: Assess a Jest suite before migration to Vitest.
output_examples.output: The assessment groups compatible assertions, mocks needing changes, snapshot considerations, configuration differences, and a staged verification sequence.

best_practices: Adapt examples to the installed Vitest version before applying them.
Keep tests isolated and restore mocks, timers, globals, and environment changes.
Run focused tests first, then verify the complete suite and coverage in CI.
anti_patterns: Do not copy configuration without checking project paths, environments, and versions.
Do not depend on test order or leave shared state between tests.
Do not update snapshots without reviewing the behavioral change.

faq.question: Does this skill run Vitest?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. An agent needs project access and permission to run commands.

faq.question: Which Vitest version does it cover?
faq.answer: The source targets Vitest 5 beta and includes documented behavior from recent versions.

faq.question: Can it help migrate from Jest?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map common APIs and highlight configuration, mocking, snapshot, and compatibility differences.

faq.question: Does it support TypeScript tests?
faq.answer: Yes. The references cover TypeScript test files, native transformation, and type-level assertions.

faq.question: Can it configure coverage?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers V8 and Istanbul providers, include patterns, exclusions, thresholds, and reports.

faq.question: Can it improve CI test workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide run mode, reporters, filtering, tags, retries, sharding, and coverage checks.
